title: merge-multisample-vcf
description: Snakemake workflow for normalizing and merging large multi-sample VCF cohorts with bcftools. Two-stage batching merges normalized inputs into batch VCFs and then a cohort-wide VCF, with recalculated variant annotations, tabix indexes, and MD5 checksums.
